list.title: Users
list.empty: This outlet has no users yet.

form.usernameHint: 3–32 lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores. Used to sign in, and can't be changed.
form.rolesHidden: Roles with permissions beyond yours aren't shown.
form.passwordHint: 8–128 characters. Pass it on to the user, who must replace it when they sign in.
form.roleHint: New permissions apply from this user's next request.
form.emailHint: Optional. An email changed here needs its user to confirm it again.

create.title: Add user
create.intro: The user signs in with the username and this temporary password, then must choose their own password.
create.managerIntro: A Manager runs this outlet: its roles, users, menus, tables and cashiers. They sign in with this temporary password, then must choose their own.

modes.own: This is your own account, so it can't be changed here.
modes.promote: The Owner manages Manager accounts. Staff accounts are their outlet's Managers' job, but you can make this user a Manager.
modes.managerAccount: Only the Owner changes a Manager's account.
modes.stronger: This user has permissions you don't, so you can't manage their account.

reset.title: Reset {{name}}'s password?
reset.body: Type a new temporary password. The user is signed out of every device at once, and must replace this password at their next sign-in.
reset.done: {{name}}'s temporary password is saved. They must replace it at their next sign-in.

promote.title: Make {{name}} a Manager?
promote.body: They get every permission in this outlet, and lose their role. They're signed out at once and need to sign in again.

demote.title: Make {{name}} staff?
demote.body: They're no longer a Manager, and their permissions follow the role you choose. They're signed out at once and need to sign in again.
demote.noRoles: This outlet has no roles yet. Create one first in the Roles tab.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.body: {{name}} is signed out at once and can't sign in. Their transactions stay in their name, and the account can be activated again.

activate.title: Activate {{name}}?
activate.body: {{name}} can sign in again with their password.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: The account is deleted and its sessions end. Its username can't be used again, and its transactions stay in its name.
